title: A/R: a credit memo voided later still shows on the earlier date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an unused $25.00 credit memo created on day C.
  • It was voided on day V, later than C (both past days).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to a day between C and V.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Look for the credit memo.
  6. Set the date chip to day V.
  7. Open every bucket.
  8. Look for the credit memo.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the credit memo is listed at $-25.00.

Step 8:

  • it is not listed.

Why this matters: A voided credit must leave the report from its void date only.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalAccountReceivableCustomerFetcher.php:238. V1 code, quoted: `->andWhere('(cm.voided_at IS NULL OR cm.voided_at > :asOfDate)')`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-022) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
